project.title: Vermifiltration of dairy wastewater
project.description: Dairy wastewater was treated using a vermifilter, a bed of woodchips seeded with earthworms to facilitate decomposition and nutrient removal. This study was conducted to survey the microbial community in the wastewater before and after vermifiltration.
